_about: Data for Biashara za Elimu+ (directory.html). Run: node build-directory.js. Entries marked sample:true are IMAGINARY and show how the directory will look. Replace them with real entries only after the owner's written consent (90-day visit) and the host organisation's approval. Never add phone numbers; use the WhatsApp link field only.

businesses.name: Mandazi ya Mama Zuhura
businesses.blurb_sw: Anauza mandazi, chapati na chai ya moto kando ya barabara kuanzia saa kumi na moja asubuhi. Wateja wake wakuu ni wafanyakazi wanaoelekea kivukoni.
businesses.blurb_en: Sells mandazi, chapati and hot tea at a roadside stall from 5 am. Her main customers are workers heading to the ferry.
businesses.quote_sw: Sasa najua faida yangu kwa kila mandazi moja, na ninaandika kila siku.
businesses.quote_en: Now I know my profit on every single mandazi, and I write it down every day.

businesses.name: Duka la Baraka
businesses.blurb_sw: Duka dogo la unga, sukari na mafuta ya kupikia yanayouzwa kwa vipimo vidogo. Anataka kukua na kuwa muuzaji wa jumla kwa majirani.
businesses.blurb_en: A small shop selling flour, sugar and cooking oil in small measures. He wants to grow into a wholesaler for his neighbours.

needs.title_sw: Kibanda chenye paa kwa mandazi na chai
needs.title_en: A covered stall for mandazi and tea
needs.detail_sw: Mvua hukatiza mauzo siku nyingi. Kibanda chenye paa na rafu ya kuonyesha bidhaa kingemwezesha kuuza hata siku za mvua.
needs.detail_en: Rain interrupts her sales on many days. A covered stall with a display shelf would let her sell on wet days too.
needs.unlock_sw: Siku za mauzo zaidi kwa wiki na bidhaa safi zaidi.
needs.unlock_en: More selling days each week and cleaner, safer food.
needs.how_sw: Kibanda kijengwe na fundi; hakuna pesa inayotolewa mkononi.
needs.how_en: Built by a craftsman; no cash is handed over.

needs.title_sw: Kununua unga na sukari kwa magunia
needs.title_en: Buying flour and sugar by the sack
needs.detail_sw: Anapanga kununua kwa magunia badala ya pakiti ndogo, kisha kuwauzia wauzaji wadogo wa karibu. Anahitaji msambazaji wa kuaminika na ushauri wa kuhifadhi bidhaa.
needs.detail_en: He plans to buy by the sack instead of small packs, then sell on to nearby small traders. He needs a reliable supplier and advice on storing stock.
needs.unlock_sw: Gharama ndogo kwa kila kipimo na kuanza kuuza kwa jumla.
needs.unlock_en: A lower cost per measure and a first step into wholesale.
needs.how_sw: Utambulisho kwa msambazaji na mshauri kupitia shirika mwenyeji.
needs.how_en: An introduction to a supplier and a mentor through the host organisation.

needs.title_sw: Mshauri wa kutunza kumbukumbu za biashara
needs.title_en: A mentor for keeping business records
needs.detail_sw: Mshauri wa kujitolea alikutana naye mara tatu na kumsaidia kuandaa daftari la mauzo na gharama.
needs.detail_en: A volunteer mentor met her three times and helped her set up a sales and expenses book.
needs.unlock_sw: Uamuzi bora wa bei na akiba.

youth.concept_sw: Kuuza mboga za majani zilizosafishwa na kukatwa tayari kwa migahawa midogo ya karibu. Ameshakamilisha SEE Canvas yake na kupima bei na gharama zake.
youth.concept_en: Selling washed, chopped leafy vegetables, ready to cook, to small restaurants nearby. She has completed her SEE Canvas and tested her prices and costs.
youth.seeks_sw: Mshauri wa biashara na mtaji wa kuanzia wa bidhaa, kupitia shirika lake.
youth.seeks_en: A business mentor and starting stock, through her organisation.
